description: This file defines extension methods for the `FileHandle` class to perform safe read operations, avoiding legacy APIs and Objective-C exceptions.

methods.name: readToEndSafely
methods.description: Reads data from the file handle until EOF using a throwing API, returning empty Data on failure.

methods.name: readSafely(upToCount:)
methods.description: Reads up to a specified number of bytes safely, returning empty Data on failure or EOF.
